run_audio_captioning_evaluation: run the EvalCap class to compute BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE, CIDEr, SPICE scores for audio captions
create_evalcap_instance: create an EvalCap instance with predicted and original caption dictionaries to evaluate audio captioning quality
compute_captioning_scores: compute BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE, CIDEr, SPICE, and SPIDEr scores by calling compute_scores on EvalCap
review_evalcap_class: review the EvalCap class and its compute_scores method for audio captioning metric evaluation
summarize_evalcap_scorers: summarize the EvalCap scorers list that configures Bleu, Meteor, Rouge, Cider, and Spice metrics
